$comment: Configuration profile (robot-capability-specs v1.5.0). settings.training copies the published booster_gym envs/T1.yaml values the MuJoCo loop (play_mujoco.py) reads; tests check them against the pinned upstream file. Nothing is tuned.
name: stock
summary: Booster Robotics' published booster_gym T1 walking policy (deploy/models/T1.pt) with the PD gains, default pose and rates of its training config envs/T1.yaml, as run by its play_mujoco.py.

nominal_base_height.ref: task profile:stand (publisher loop, zero command: trunk 0.667 m)

fall_base_height.reason: About two-thirds of the standing trunk height, the rule used for the G1.

settings.gait_note: play_mujoco.py sets the gait frequency to the average of commands.gait_frequency (1.5 Hz) for any non-zero command and to 0 (phase terms zeroed) for a zero command. The runner's phase term is always on, so only non-zero commands are run.
settings.action_note: play_mujoco.py clips actions to +/- normalization.clip_actions (1.0) before targets and last_action; runner v1.4.0 does not clip. task reference measures whether any action reaches the limit.
settings.deploy_note: The real-robot deploy/configs/T1.yaml differs (ankle damping 3, gait_frequency 1); it is pinned for the record but not used: this configuration is the publisher's MuJoCo setup.
settings.actuation: pd_torque: every 0.002 s physics step runs mj_step1, writes kp (q* - q) - kd dq from current state into the model's <motor> actuators (ctrlrange = published torque limits, clamped by MuJoCo as play_mujoco.py clips), then mj_step2
